plain.li: I dreamt I could fly, but only about a hand's width off the ground. It was still the best night I've had in years.
I dreamt I flew over the colony and saw how small it is. Everyone was asleep, and I kept watch from the clouds.
I dreamt I could fly if I just remembered to forget about the ground. I kept remembering.
[child] I dreamt I could fly, and I flew right over the grown-ups and they couldn't catch me!
[old] I dreamt I was flying, and my knees didn't hurt at all. I didn't come down until morning.
[winter] I dreamt I flew south with the birds and found a place where it was always spring.
[tribal] I dreamt I was a hawk riding the warm air over the hunting grounds. I could see every rabbit.
[spacer] I dreamt I flew without a ship, just me and the stars, and nobody asked for my clearance codes.
[trait:Wimp] I dreamt I could fly, so I flew away from everything. Nothing could reach me up there.
[again] Flying again. I'm getting better at the landings.

warm.li: I dreamt I could fly, and I carried everyone up one at a time to see the view. Nobody was scared.

blunt.li: Dreamt I could fly. Woke up. Couldn't.

cheerful.li: I FLEW! In the dream! I did loops over the kitchen and nobody yelled at me!

gloomy.li: I dreamt I could fly. Then I remembered I couldn't, halfway up, and fell.

cold.li: I dreamt of flight. The physics were wrong, but I enjoyed it anyway.

plain.li: I dreamt I had to speak before the whole council and I'd forgotten every word. Then my teeth started falling out.
I dreamt I'd been put in charge of something important. Nobody would tell me what it was, and it was already late.
I dreamt I turned up to the council meeting with no clothes on. Nobody noticed, which was somehow worse.
[newcomer] I dreamt everyone here knew the rules except me, and they were all too polite to explain them.
[trait:Nervous|trait:Volatile] I dreamt I was holding the whole colony together with one hand, and my hand was getting tired.
[teen] I dreamt the adults handed me the keys to everything and went on holiday. I couldn't find the right key.
[again] The council dream again. Still no words. Still no trousers.

blunt.li: Dreamt I was supposed to do something and didn't. Woke up and checked. I did it.

cheerful.li: I dreamt I gave a speech in my underwear and they CLAPPED! Weirdest dream I've ever had!

gloomy.li: I dreamt I let everyone down. It wasn't hard to imagine.

cold.li: An anxiety dream. Missed deadlines, missing teeth. Textbook.

plain.li: I dreamt I did {SKILL} all night long. I woke up more tired than when I went to bed.
I dreamt I was doing {SKILL} for someone I couldn't see, and every time I finished, there was more.
[skill:Mining] I dreamt I was digging, and the rock kept whispering 'almost there.' It was lying.
[skill:Cooking] I dreamt the cooking pot had no bottom, and everyone was still hungry.
[skill:Plants] I dreamt the potatoes were following me around the field, waiting to be planted.
[skill:Construction] I dreamt I was building a wall that went all the way around the world. I was nearly done.
[skill:Crafting] I dreamt I was sewing the same shirt over and over, and it fit nobody.
[skill:Medicine] I dreamt I was stitching up a patient who kept saying it didn't hurt. I couldn't find the wound.
[skill:Animals] I dreamt I was milking a cow that never ran dry. I was there for years.
[skill:Intellectual] I dreamt I'd finished the research, but the answer was written in a language I don't speak.
[skill:Artistic] I dreamt I carved a statue so beautiful that it got up and walked off without me.
[skill:Shooting|skill:Melee] I dreamt I was on guard, and the night lasted a hundred years, and nothing ever came.
[skill:Social] I dreamt I was in a conversation that never ended. I kept nodding. My neck hurt when I woke up.
[trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] I dreamt about work. That's the worst kind of nightmare there is.
[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] I dreamt about work all night. Best sleep I've had in a week.

blunt.li: Dreamt about work. Then got up and did work. Same thing, twice.

cheerful.li: I dreamt I finished ALL the work in the colony! Then I woke up and it was all back. Oh well!

gloomy.li: Even in my sleep, there's work. There's always work.

cold.li: I spent the night rehearsing tasks. Inefficient, but the mind does what it does.

plain.li: I dreamt I could understand the chickens. It was all complaints, mostly about the rooster.
I dreamt a thrumbo was sleeping in my bed and I had to sleep on the floor. It snored like a landslide.
I dreamt a boomalope gave everyone a long talk about fire safety. It was very thorough.
[skill:Animals] I dreamt I walked through the forest and every animal I met knew my name and wanted a scratch behind the ears.
[child] I dreamt I had an alpaca small enough to fit in my pocket, and it went everywhere with me.
[tribal] I dreamt the animal spirits came to sit by our fire, and the great elk told a story about the first hunt.
[winter] I dreamt the muffalo let me sleep between them where it was warm. They smelled terrible. I didn't care.

warm.li: I dreamt every animal we ever tamed came to thank me. Even the ones that bit me.

blunt.li: Dreamt about animals. They were fine. I was fine.

cheerful.li: I dreamt I was riding a giant squirrel through the treetops! Best dream EVER!

gloomy.li: I dreamt the animals were talking about us, and none of it was good.

cold.li: I dreamt I understood what the animals were saying. They're as foolish as I expected.

plain.li: I dreamt the colony was on fire and everyone was asleep. I shouted and shouted and nobody woke.
I dreamt I was carrying water to a fire, but every bucket I brought was full of sand.
[summer|hot] I dreamt the grass caught fire and ran toward us like a wave. I can still smell the smoke.
[winter] I dreamt we lit a fire to keep warm, and it got hungry and started eating the walls.
[child] I dreamt there was fire in the hallway and it was laughing at me.
[again] The fire again. This time I knew where the water was, and I still didn't get there.

warm.li: I dreamt of a fire and I got everyone out. Every single one. I counted twice when I woke up.

blunt.li: Fire dream. Checked where the water is. Not taking chances.

cheerful.li: I dreamt there was a fire, but I put it out with my hat! Then I woke up and my hat was fine!

gloomy.li: I dreamt the colony burned down. Part of me wasn't even surprised.

cold.li: A dream about fire. I'll review how fast we could put one out. The dream had a point.

plain.li: I dreamt a centipede walked through the colony very politely, checking our names off a list.
I dreamt the machines were digging under the colony. I could hear them through my pillow.
I dreamt I was a machine, and someone was very disappointed in my programming.
[tribal|medieval] I dreamt of iron spirits with no faces, walking in a line, and the ground hummed where they stepped.
[spacer] I dreamt the hive had already won, and I was the last one who hadn't noticed.
[again] The machines again. They're closer this time.

blunt.li: Dreamt about mechanoids. Hate those things. Even asleep.

cheerful.li: I dreamt a scyther tried to cut my hair! It did a terrible job! I woke up laughing!

gloomy.li: I dreamt the machines didn't even bother to attack. They just waited for us to finish dying.

cold.li: I dreamt the mechanoids were assessing us. Rationally, they always are.

plain.li: I dreamt the moon came down close enough to touch. It was warm, and it hummed like a cat.
I dreamt the sky was an ocean, and something huge was swimming in it, just above the clouds.
[rain] I dreamt every raindrop had a tiny voice, and they were all saying the same word. I've forgotten it.
[snow] I dreamt the snow was falling up, back into the sky, and the ground underneath was warm.
[fog] I dreamt the fog was a crowd of people, all looking for the same door.
[storm] I dreamt I caught a lightning bolt in a jar. It's still in there, somewhere.
[clear,night] I dreamt I was lying on the roof counting stars, and every time I counted one, another went out.
[spacer] I dreamt I could see the ship that brought me here, still up there, going around and around.
[child] I dreamt the clouds were sheep and I was the shepherd. One of them got away.

warm.li: I dreamt the whole colony lay in the grass watching the sky change colours, and nobody had anywhere to be.

cheerful.li: I dreamt the sky was full of kites, thousands of them, and every one had someone's name on it!

gloomy.li: I dreamt the sky was a lid, and someone was about to close it.

cold.li: I dreamt the stars had been rearranged overnight. I checked this morning: they hadn't.

plain.li: I dreamt of a pie as big as a door. We had to eat our way out of the kitchen.
I dreamt of fresh bread so clearly I could smell it. I woke up hungry and happy.
[trait:Gourmand] I dreamt of a meal with twelve courses, and I tasted every one. I'm ruined for paste forever.
[trait:Ascetic] I dreamt of a bowl of plain rice. It was perfect. Nothing else was needed.
[poor] I dreamt the larder was so full we had to keep the door shut with a chair.
[winter] I dreamt of summer berries, still warm from the sun. I could taste them for an hour after I woke.
[child] I dreamt there was a room made of sweets, and nobody told me to stop.
[tribal] I dreamt of a great hunt and the meal after, with the fat dripping into the fire and everyone singing.
[spacer] I dreamt of a meal from home, the real kind, not printed. I can still taste it.

warm.li: I dreamt I was cooking for everyone, and everyone came back for seconds.

blunt.li: Dreamt about food. Now I'm hungry. Thanks, brain.

cheerful.li: I dreamt of a cake taller than me! I climbed it! I ate the top!

gloomy.li: I dreamt of a feast. Then I woke up to whatever we're having.

cold.li: I dreamt of food. My body is signalling a need. Noted.

plain.li: I dreamt I was someone else entirely, with a different name, a different face and a job I was good at.
I dreamt I had never come to this planet. I had a little house and a dull life and I was happy. I think.
[tribal] I dreamt I lived in a tower of glass, where food came out of the wall and nobody ever went hunting.
[spacer] I dreamt I was born a tribal hunter, and everything was simple, and I knew every plant by name.
[medieval] I dreamt I was a lord in a stone castle, and everyone bowed, and I was bored out of my skull.
[old] I dreamt I was young again, with my whole life ahead of me, and I made all the same choices.
[teen] I dreamt I was very old and everyone listened to me. I said a lot of nonsense.
[trait:Greedy] I dreamt I was rich, really rich, on a glitterworld. I still wanted more.
[again] That other life again. I'm starting to know my way around it.

warm.li: I dreamt of another life, a gentler one. I'm glad I woke up here, though. You're all here.

blunt.li: Dreamt I was someone else. They had it easier. Whatever.

cheerful.li: I dreamt I was a famous singer on a glitterworld! I'm going to sing at breakfast!

gloomy.li: I dreamt of the life I could have had. This one doesn't compare.

cold.li: I dreamt I was a different person. That person made better choices. Instructive.

plain.li: I dreamt there was a huge face in the sky, deciding what would happen to us next. It looked bored.
I dreamt someone far away was watching us, moving us around like pieces on a board, and laughing.
I dreamt a voice was telling our story to someone else. It kept skipping the good parts.
[trait:PsychicallySensitive|trait:PsychicallyHypersensitive] I dreamt something vast turned to look at us, the way you'd look at an anthill. Then it looked away.
[afterraid] I dreamt the watcher was pleased with the fight. It wanted another one.
[child] I dreamt a giant was playing with us like toys, but it was being careful not to break us.
[again] The watcher again. I swear it waved this time.

blunt.li: Dreamt something up there was watching us. If it's listening: stop.

cheerful.li: I dreamt we were all characters in someone's story! I hope I'm one of the main ones!

gloomy.li: I dreamt we were being watched by something that enjoys it when things go wrong. That explains a lot.

cold.li: I dreamt we were being observed by something that finds us entertaining. I see no reason to doubt it.

plain.li: I dreamt I was the biggest person in the colony and everyone had to ask ME if they could have dessert.
I dreamt I was a grown-up and I could stay up as late as I wanted. I fell asleep anyway.
I dreamt I found a door in the wall that went to a secret room only kids could fit in.
I dreamt I threw the moon like a ball, and it bounced all the way home.
[winter] I dreamt I built a snow fort so big the whole colony moved in.
[again] I had the secret door dream again! It's real. I just have to find it.

warm.li: I dreamt everyone in the colony came to my birthday party and nobody had to work.

blunt.li: Dreamt I was big. I'm still small. Not fair.

cheerful.li: I dreamt I could jump over the houses! Everyone was cheering!

gloomy.li: I dreamt I was a grown-up. It was mostly chores.

cold.li: I dreamt I was in charge. My rules were better.

plain.li: I dreamt all the grown-ups forgot how to talk and only made muffalo noises, and nobody could tell me what to do.
I dreamt I was lost in the corn and it was taller than the house, and I could hear everyone calling but not where from.
I dreamt my shadow got up and went somewhere without me.
[night] I dreamt the house was breathing, slowly, and I was the only one who could hear it.
[afterraid] I dreamt the bad people came back and I had to hide in the cupboard, and the cupboard was too small.
[grieving] I dreamt I couldn't find anybody, and then I woke up and remembered someone really is gone.
[again] The shadow dream again. I'm sleeping with a light on.

warm.li: I had a bad dream, but then I dreamt someone came and sat with me until it went away.

blunt.li: Bad dream. I'm not scared. Much.

cheerful.li: I had a scary dream, but I punched the monster on the nose and it ran away crying!

gloomy.li: I had a bad dream. I don't want to go to sleep ever again.

cold.li: I dreamt of a monster. Monsters aren't real. I checked anyway.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream from the other side

plain.li: I dreamt I was one of the raiders, walking up to our walls. I could see myself in the window, aiming at me.
I dreamt I was lying out in the field where they fell, and I could hear what they were thinking. They were scared too.
[tribal] I dreamt I wore the enemy's paint and ran with them, and I didn't know which side I was on until the arrows came.
[spacer] I dreamt I was in their drop pod, coming down hard, and someone next to me was praying.
[trait:Bloodlust] I dreamt I was one of them, coming at us. I didn't last long. We're good at this.
[again] I keep dreaming I'm on the wrong side of the wall. I always lose.

warm.li: I dreamt I was one of the raiders. They had people waiting for them too. I can't stop thinking about that.

blunt.li: Dreamt I was a raider. Got shot. By me.

gloomy.li: I dreamt I was one of the ones we killed. It was easy to imagine. Too easy.

cold.li: I dreamt the fight from the enemy's position. Their approach was obvious. Ours should be less so.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the butcher's table

plain.li: I dreamt the meat on my plate kept trying to tell me its name. I didn't let it finish.
I dreamt I was back at the butcher's table, and the knife wouldn't come clean no matter how hard I scrubbed.
I dreamt the one we butchered was sitting at the table with us, waiting politely for a plate.
[again] The butcher's table again. My hands won't come clean.

warm.li: I dreamt we gave them a proper burial instead. I wish that's what we'd done.

blunt.li: Dreamt about what I did at the butcher's table. Not talking about it.

gloomy.li: I dreamt I was the one on the table. Nobody hesitated.

cold.li: I dreamt about the butchering. My stomach turned on waking. Odd, since I felt nothing at the time.

plain.li: I dreamt the body we left out there got up and asked, very politely, why nobody had buried it.
I dreamt the dead were standing out in the field in a line, waiting for someone to tell them where to go.
[rain] I dreamt the rain was washing the bodies toward the colony, and they were knocking on the walls.
[summer|hot] I dreamt the smell came inside and lay down in my bed, and I had to sleep next to it.
[again] The dead in the field again. They're getting impatient.

warm.li: I dreamt we buried them all, ours and theirs, and someone said a few words. It felt right.

blunt.li: Dreamt about the bodies. Someone bury them. I'll do it myself if I have to.

gloomy.li: I dreamt nobody would ever bury me either. I'd just lie there like the rest.

cold.li: I dreamt of the corpses. A disease risk, mostly. They should be dealt with.

plain.li: I dreamt I was on trial, and the judge was the one we sent away. The verdict took a very long time.
I dreamt the whole colony was a set of scales, and someone kept adding weights to the wrong side.
I dreamt someone was knocking on the gate all night, asking to be let back in.
[trait:Kind] I dreamt I stood up and said no. In the dream, everyone listened.
[again] The trial again. I still don't know the verdict.

warm.li: I dreamt we found another way. I keep thinking there must have been one.

blunt.li: Dreamt about what we did. Was it right? It's done now, either way.

gloomy.li: I dreamt they'll do the same to me one day. Maybe they should.

cold.li: A dream about the decision. I still think it was correct. The dream disagreed.

plain.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was still at the workbench, finishing something, and told me not to wait up.
I dreamt I passed {OTHER_nameDef} in the hall and we nodded like it was any other day. It was so ordinary I didn't notice until I woke.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was sitting on the edge of my bed, saying it was all right. I almost believed it.
[winter] I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was out in the snow, waving at me to come and see something. The footprints only went one way.
[again] {OTHER_nameDef} again. Same chair. I keep meaning to ask what it's like, over there.

warm.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} came back to tell me it didn't hurt. I'm choosing to believe that.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef}. Still dead. Still not fair.

gloomy.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} asked why we didn't save {OTHER_objective}. I had nothing to say.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} appeared in my sleep. Grief, I assume. It was less unpleasant than I expected.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of an old companion

plain.li: I dreamt my animal came back, muddy and pleased with itself, as if it had only been out hunting.
I dreamt I heard paws outside my door. I opened it and the yard was full of sunlight and nobody was there.
I dreamt we were walking our old route together again, and neither of us was in any hurry.
[child] I dreamt my animal friend was waiting at the end of the field, and let me hold on while it ran.
[again] Paws at the door again. I keep getting up to check.

warm.li: I dreamt my old companion lay down at my feet like always. I'd forgotten how warm that was.

blunt.li: Dreamt my animal came back. It didn't.

gloomy.li: I dreamt I called and called and nothing came. That part, at least, was true.

cold.li: I dreamt of the animal. Attachment is inconvenient. I miss it anyway.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a broken heart

plain.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was packing a bag, and every time I unpacked it, it filled up again.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was on the other side of a river, waving, and with every step I took the river got wider.
I dreamt I was telling {OTHER_nameDef} everything I should have said. {OTHER_nameDef} just kept eating breakfast.
[rain] I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were standing in the rain, and only I was getting wet.
[again] {OTHER_nameDef} again. I'd like my sleep back, please.

warm.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was happy, just not with me. I think I can live with that. Eventually.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef}. Woke up angry. Staying angry.

gloomy.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} never loved me at all. It made a terrible kind of sense.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} appeared in a dream. I'll consider it a temporary malfunction.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a long talk

plain.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I kept talking after everyone else had gone to bed, until the sun came up and joined in.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} told me something important, and I said 'I know,' and somehow we both did.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were walking down a road that kept going, and neither of us wanted to turn back.
[winter] I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I sat by the fire all winter, and we never ran out of things to say.
[again] I dreamt about talking with {OTHER_nameDef} again. I hope we do it again awake.

warm.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} said something kind, and it was exactly what {OTHER_pronoun} really said. Some things are worth hearing twice.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef}. We talked. It was good.

cheerful.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I talked for a WHOLE night! We should do that for real!

gloomy.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was being kind to me. Then I woke up worried it was only the dream.

cold.li: I dreamt about my conversation with {OTHER_nameDef}. Apparently it mattered to me. Interesting.

plain.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was whispering to the walls, and the walls were whispering to everyone.
I dreamt I walked into the dining room and everyone stopped talking. {OTHER_nameDef} was smiling.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was writing something about me on every door in the colony. I couldn't read any of it.
[again] Whispers again, and {OTHER_nameDef} again. I'm starting to whisper back.

warm.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} said sorry. I'd like to think {OTHER_pronoun} meant it.

blunt.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was talking behind my back. Probably was. I'll ask.

gloomy.li: I dreamt everyone agreed with what {OTHER_nameDef} said about me. Maybe they do.

cold.li: I dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef} and the remarks. I'm giving them more attention than they deserve.

plain.li: I dreamt the party never ended. We were still dancing when the harvest came in.
I dreamt everyone was dancing, even the animals, even the people who can't dance. Especially them.
I dreamt the music kept playing after we all went to bed, and the colony danced by itself.
[child] I dreamt I danced on the table and nobody told me to get down!
[winter] I dreamt we danced so hard the snow melted.

warm.li: I dreamt of everyone's faces at the celebration. I'd like to remember them like that forever.

blunt.li: Dreamt about the party. Good party.

cheerful.li: I dreamt the party went on for a WEEK! We should do that! Can we do that?

gloomy.li: I dreamt of the party. Even the happy dreams end.

cold.li: I dreamt of the celebration. I suppose I enjoyed it more than I let on.

plain.li: I dreamt I was trying to sleep in a bed that kept sliding to the other side of the room.
I dreamt someone was building a house around me while I slept, and it wasn't finished by morning.
[cold|winter] I dreamt I was a block of ice, and someone was carving me into a statue of myself. It was a good likeness.
[hot|summer] I dreamt I was a loaf of bread in an oven, and someone kept opening the door to check on me.
[rain] I dreamt I was a fish, which made the wet a lot easier to deal with.
[large] I dreamt everyone's snoring was a choir and I was conducting. We were terrible.
[tribal] I dreamt the ground was a great animal and I was sleeping on its back. It breathed all night.
[again] Another bad night, another strange dream. I'd like a proper bed.

warm.li: I dreamt someone tucked a blanket around me in the night. I don't know who. Thank you, whoever you are.

blunt.li: Bad sleep, weird dream. Need a real bed.

cheerful.li: I dreamt my bed was a boat and I sailed it all night! Woke up seasick but happy!

gloomy.li: I dreamt I'd never sleep properly again. My back agrees.

cold.li: Poor sleeping conditions produced an odd dream. I'd like the conditions corrected.

plain.li: I dreamt my blood was full of tiny raiders, and my body was holding the line one wall at a time.
I dreamt I was a house with all the windows open, and the wind kept blowing through, and nobody would close them.
I dreamt the doctor was a muffalo. It was very gentle. It had no idea what it was doing.
[cold] I dreamt I was sitting inside a glacier, and it was quiet and blue and I didn't want to leave. That frightens me.
[hot] I dreamt I was sitting inside the sun. It was pleasant, at first.
[fever] I dreamt the bed was a raft and the fever was a sea, and someone kept rowing me back to shore.
[child] I dreamt the sickness was a little grey animal sitting on my chest, and it wouldn't get off.
[again] I keep dreaming my body is a fort under siege. I'm holding.

warm.li: I dreamt everyone came to sit by my bed, one at a time, and each of them brought something warm.

blunt.li: Sick. Dreamt I was sick. Even my dreams are boring.

cheerful.li: I dreamt I fought the sickness with a sword! I'm definitely winning!

gloomy.li: I dreamt I'd been sick forever and everyone had stopped visiting.

cold.li: I dreamt my immune system was losing. I'd prefer it didn't.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the long dark

plain.li: I dreamt I was lying in a field and the grass grew over me, slowly, and it was peaceful, until someone pulled me out.
I dreamt I was at the bottom of a deep well, and I could hear everyone at the top talking about me.
I dreamt I was a candle in a big dark room, and everyone who walked past cupped their hands around me so I wouldn't go out.
[afterraid] I dreamt the fight was still going on somewhere far above me, muffled, like a party in another room.
[spacer] I dreamt I was drifting between the stars with no suit, and it didn't matter, and the stars were singing.
[tribal] I dreamt I walked the spirit road a long way, and the ancestors sent me back. They said it wasn't time.
[child] I dreamt I was very small inside a very big quiet, and then I heard someone calling me in for dinner.
[again] The long dark again. I know the way back now.

warm.li: I dreamt I was floating somewhere dark, and a hand kept holding mine. I think it was real.

blunt.li: Was out cold. Dreamt of nothing much, just dark. Then here.

gloomy.li: I dreamt of the dark. It was quiet there. It's loud here.

cold.li: Unconscious. Fragments of a well, voices above. Nothing useful.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a lost seat

plain.li: I dreamt my seat on the council had been sawn into firewood, and everyone was warming their hands over it.
I dreamt I kept walking into the council and someone else was always sitting in my place, wearing my face.
I dreamt I gave a speech to an empty room, and the room voted against me.
[again] The council dream again. Still standing at the back.

warm.li: I dreamt I shook hands with whoever has my seat now. I don't know if I meant it. Maybe one day I will.

blunt.li: Dreamt about the vote. Lost it twice. Once was enough.

gloomy.li: I dreamt they were all relieved I was gone. They were smiling about it.

cold.li: I dreamt about the vote. The next one will go differently.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a friend's betrayal

plain.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} locked the gate behind me and walked away whistling.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} sold me to a passing trader for a handful of silver and a sack of rice.
I dreamt I was drowning and {OTHER_nameDef} was standing on the bank, deciding.
[afterraid] I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} opened the doors for the raiders and smiled at me while they came in.

warm.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} betrayed me. I know it's nonsense. I still couldn't look at {OTHER_objective} at breakfast.

blunt.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} sold me out. Watching {OTHER_objective} today.

gloomy.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} turned on me. Everyone does, eventually.

cold.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} betrayed me. Improbable. I'll keep it in mind anyway.

plain.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I swore to look after each other, whatever came, and the words were carved into the hill.
I dreamt the world was ending, and {OTHER_nameDef} came to find me first. I would have done the same.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were very old and still arguing about the same silly thing. I've never been happier.

warm.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I made a promise to stick together. I'm keeping it, dream or no dream.

blunt.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I swore an oath. Didn't need a dream for it. Still counts.

cheerful.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were friends forever! Which we are! It's official now!

gloomy.li: I dreamt I lost everything except {OTHER_nameDef}. It was enough. That surprised me.

cold.li: I dreamt I would die for {OTHER_nameDef}. I've checked my reasoning. It holds.

plain.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I fought a duel with soup spoons in front of the whole colony. Nobody won. The soup got cold.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I raced to the end of the world. {OTHER_nameDef} cheated. I'm almost sure.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were the last two people alive, and we still couldn't agree on anything.
[medieval] I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I jousted on muffalo. I was robbed.
[again] Another duel with {OTHER_nameDef}. I'm ahead on points.

blunt.li: Dreamt I beat {OTHER_nameDef} in a fight. Fair and square. Remember that.

cheerful.li: I dreamt I beat {OTHER_nameDef} at arm wrestling! It's practically a prophecy!

gloomy.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} won. Of course {OTHER_pronoun} did.

cold.li: I dreamt of a contest with {OTHER_nameDef}. I lost on a technicality. That won't happen awake.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a rival's sorrow

plain.li: I dreamt I found {OTHER_nameDef} crying alone in the storeroom. I didn't know {OTHER_pronoun} could.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was a child, lost and cold, and I was the only one who could see {OTHER_objective}.
I dreamt I saw the world through {OTHER_possessive} eyes for a day. It was harder than I thought.

warm.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was hurting, and I was the one who went to help. I don't know if I'd do it awake. I'd like to.

blunt.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was miserable. Didn't enjoy it as much as I thought I would.

gloomy.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was as lonely as I am. That's not nothing.

cold.li: I dreamt of {OTHER_nameDef} at a weak moment. I felt sympathy instead of advantage. Irritating.

plain.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were back to back in the dark, surrounded, and I wasn't afraid at all.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I held a bridge against an army. We were laughing the whole time.
I dreamt I fell in the mud and {OTHER_nameDef} hauled me up without breaking stride.
[afterraid] I dreamt the fight again, but {OTHER_nameDef} was always exactly where I needed {OTHER_objective} to be.
[tribal] I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I hunted the great beast together, and we shared the heart by the fire.

warm.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} covered me while I pulled someone out of the line of fire. That's just how it is with us.

blunt.li: Dreamt I was in a fight with {OTHER_nameDef} at my back. Good place for {OTHER_objective}.

cheerful.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I took on a whole army and WON! We're unstoppable!

cold.li: I dreamt of combat alongside {OTHER_nameDef}. Our coordination was excellent. It usually is.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a fallen comrade

plain.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} went down in the fight and I didn't get there in time. I'm getting there in time from now on.
I dreamt I was carrying {OTHER_nameDef} out of the smoke, and every step {OTHER_nameDef} got heavier, and I didn't put {OTHER_objective} down.
I dreamt I heard {OTHER_nameDef} calling for help over the guns, and every way I ran was the wrong way.

warm.li: I dreamt I lost {OTHER_nameDef}. I'm going to be standing a lot closer from now on.

blunt.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} died on my watch. Not happening. Not while I'm standing.

gloomy.li: I dreamt I buried {OTHER_nameDef}. I can still feel the shovel in my hands.

cold.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was killed. Unacceptable. I'll stay closer in the next fight.

plain.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was teaching {SKILL} to me, and I learned something I didn't know I'd missed.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was the best at {SKILL} on the whole planet, and everyone asked who taught {OTHER_objective}. I didn't have to say.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} got it wrong, again and again, and on the hundredth try got it right. I cheered so loud I woke myself up.
[old] I dreamt I was gone, and {OTHER_nameDef} was teaching {SKILL} to someone else, in my words. That's enough for me.

warm.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} thanked me. I haven't done enough to deserve it yet. I'll get there.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef} doing {SKILL}. Getting better. Don't say I said so.

cheerful.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was a master of {SKILL} and it was all because of ME!

gloomy.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} gave up on {SKILL}. I'll make sure that doesn't happen.

cold.li: I dreamt about the lessons with {OTHER_nameDef}. I'll revise the method.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a botched lesson

plain.li: I dreamt I made a mess of {SKILL} in front of {OTHER_nameDef}, and {OTHER_nameDef} just sighed, for a very long time.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} asked me a question about {SKILL} and I answered in a language I don't speak.
I dreamt I had to do {SKILL} in front of the whole colony while {OTHER_nameDef} held up a sign with a number on it. The number was low.
[child] I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} gave me a test and all my answers were drawings of muffalo.

warm.li: I dreamt I let {OTHER_nameDef} down. I'm going to practise twice as hard so I never do.

blunt.li: Dreamt I botched a lesson. Practising today.

cheerful.li: I dreamt I set {OTHER_possessive} workbench on fire! Note to self: don't do that!

gloomy.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} realised I'll never be any good at {SKILL}. Maybe that's already happened.

cold.li: I dreamt I failed a lesson with {OTHER_nameDef}. A useful warning against complacency.

plain.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was on the other side of a glass wall, talking, and I couldn't hear a word.
I dreamt I was waiting for {OTHER_nameDef} at the gate, and everyone came home except {OTHER_objective}.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were in different rooms of the same house, and every door I opened led further away.
[winter] I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} walked out into a blizzard to fetch something for me, and the snow closed up behind {OTHER_objective}.

warm.li: I dreamt I couldn't reach {OTHER_nameDef}. This morning I made a point of reaching {OTHER_objective}. Twice.

blunt.li: Dreamt I couldn't get to {OTHER_nameDef}. Got there this morning. Problem solved.

gloomy.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} finally saw me clearly and left. I keep waiting for it.

cold.li: A dream of separation from {OTHER_nameDef}. Disquieting. I'll spend more time with {OTHER_objective}.

plain.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were at a long table with everyone in our family, even the ones neither of us ever met. They all knew us.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were both small, playing in a house I don't remember, and someone was calling us in for dinner.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were walking back to a house that's long gone, and the lights were on.
[child] I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} carried me on {OTHER_possessive} shoulders all the way around the colony, and I could see everything.
[old] I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was a baby again, and I was holding {OTHER_objective}, and nobody was afraid of anything.

warm.li: I dreamt of {OTHER_nameDef} and our whole family, and nobody was missing. Blood is blood.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef}. Family. Wouldn't trade them.

cheerful.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I had a giant family picnic and everyone came!

gloomy.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were the last of our family. We are, more or less.

cold.li: I dreamt of {OTHER_nameDef}. Shared blood apparently means more to me than I admit.

plain.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was the only one in the colony who could see me. We didn't talk about it.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} told me a secret, and the secret was my own name.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were stuck on a raft together for a year. We learned a lot about each other.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was building something in the middle of the night and wouldn't say what.
[again] {OTHER_nameDef} again. Why {OTHER_nameDef}?

warm.li: I dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef}. I'm not sure what it meant, but I'm going to say good morning properly today.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef}. No idea why. Moving on.

cheerful.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} could juggle fire! Can {OTHER_pronoun}? I'm going to ask!

gloomy.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was leaving and didn't say goodbye. I don't know why that bothered me so much.

cold.li: I dreamt of {OTHER_nameDef}. Something is being processed. I'll pay closer attention.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a last goodbye

plain.li: I dreamt I got to say goodbye to {LOST} properly this time. I said everything. {LOST} just smiled and said, 'I know.'
I dreamt {LOST} walked me to the edge of a bright field, hugged me, and went on alone. I didn't follow. I think that was right.
I dreamt {LOST} gave me something small to keep. I woke up with my hand closed tight around nothing.
[child] I dreamt {LOST} tucked me in and told me a story, and said it was all right to be happy again.
[grieving] I dreamt I asked {LOST} if it hurt. {LOST} laughed and said I always worried too much.
[again] {LOST} said goodbye again last night. It gets a little easier each time.

warm.li: I said goodbye to {LOST} last night, in a dream. I feel lighter. I think {LOST} wanted that.

blunt.li: Said goodbye to {LOST} in a dream. Should've done it while I could.

gloomy.li: I dreamt I said goodbye to {LOST}. Then I woke up and had to do it all over again.

cold.li: A dream of farewell with {LOST}. Sentimental. Apparently necessary.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a lost animal

plain.li: I dreamt {PET_nameDef} ran off into the fog and wouldn't come when I called. I could hear it, further and further away.
I dreamt I was looking for {PET_nameDef} everywhere, and every animal I found had the wrong face.
I dreamt {PET_nameDef} was on the far side of a river, waiting for me to cross, and I couldn't swim.
[child] I dreamt {PET_nameDef} got too big to fit through the door and had to sleep outside forever.
[afterraid] I dreamt {PET_nameDef} was hurt in the fight and I couldn't find where. I checked every scratch this morning.

warm.li: I dreamt I lost {PET_nameDef}. First thing I did this morning was find a treat and an excuse.

blunt.li: Dreamt {PET_nameDef} went missing. Didn't. Checked.

cheerful.li: I dreamt {PET_nameDef} ran away, but it turned out to be a surprise party! For me!

gloomy.li: I dreamt {PET_nameDef} forgot me. Animals don't hold on to much.

cold.li: I dreamt {PET_nameDef} wandered off. I'll inspect the pens.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the hard days

plain.li: I dreamt it was the first winter again and we were eating the seed grain. I woke up and my bed felt like a palace.
I dreamt we were back in the early days, sleeping on the floor and sharing one pot. We were happier than we knew.
[tribal] I dreamt of the lean months before this place, chewing bark by the fire. Today's meal will taste like a feast.
[spacer] I dreamt I was back in the crashed pod, rationing water. This place is luxury. I'd forgotten.
[newcomer] I dreamt of the road that brought me here. I'm glad to have a roof at all.
[rich] I dreamt we had nothing, and it was fine. We'd figure it out. We always do.

warm.li: I dreamt of the hard days, when all we had was each other. We still have that. That's plenty.

blunt.li: Dreamt about the bad old days. Today's fine by comparison.

cheerful.li: I dreamt we were starving and freezing, and then I woke up in a WARM BED! What a world!

gloomy.li: I dreamt of the old hunger. It's waiting, I'm sure. But not today.

cold.li: A dream of past scarcity. It recalibrated my expectations. Useful.

plain.li: I dreamt of a shape, a curve really, and I've been seeing it everywhere since I woke. I need to make it.
I dreamt I walked through a gallery of things I haven't made yet. I remember three of them.
I dreamt the stone was already a statue, and all I had to do was take away the parts that weren't.
[tribal] I dreamt the ancestors painted on the cave wall beside me, and showed me the colours they'd kept hidden.

warm.li: I dreamt of something beautiful I could make for everyone. I'm going to make it.

blunt.li: Had an idea in my sleep. Out of my way.

cheerful.li: I dreamt the most beautiful thing I've ever seen and I'm going to MAKE it!

gloomy.li: I dreamt of something beautiful. I'd better make it before it fades like everything else.

cold.li: A complete design arrived during sleep. I'll begin before I lose the details.

plain.li: I dreamt I was shooting at targets that kept running away, and I hit every one. I can still feel the rhythm of it.
I dreamt I could see the wind, every gust of it, and where each shot would land.
I dreamt I was firing at a raider who moved exactly like me. I learned a lot about how I move.
[lowtech] I dreamt I loosed arrow after arrow at a running deer, and each one went exactly where I looked.

blunt.li: Dreamt about shooting. Hit everything. Going to the range.

cheerful.li: I dreamt I shot an apple off a muffalo's head! The muffalo was fine! I was AMAZING!

gloomy.li: I dreamt I missed every shot that mattered. Then I took them again, one by one, until I didn't.

cold.li: I spent the night rehearsing my aim. I expect better accuracy today.

plain.li: I dreamt I was a mountain, and the wind and the raiders and the winters broke against me, and I didn't move.
I dreamt I stood in the gate alone, and everything that came through it turned back. I woke up very calm.
I dreamt my bones were made of iron. I can still feel them.
[trait:Nervous|trait:Volatile] I dreamt my fear was a small animal, and I picked it up and put it in my pocket. It's still in there. It's quiet.
[afterraid] I dreamt the next attack came, and I was ready for it. I still am.

warm.li: I dreamt I was standing between the colony and the dark. Everyone I love was behind me. I wasn't afraid.

blunt.li: Dreamt I was a mountain. Feel like one. Bring it.

cheerful.li: I dreamt I was a mountain! Today, I'm basically a mountain!

gloomy.li: I dreamt nothing could hurt me anymore. For one day, I'll pretend that's true.

cold.li: I dreamt of being immovable. My nerves have settled. Good.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the council fire

plain.li: I dreamt the council sat around one big fire, and every voice was heard, even mine. Even the quiet ones.
I dreamt the council chamber had no walls, and anyone could walk in and be heard. Nobody shouted.
I dreamt we voted on something hard and everyone agreed, and then we all went to dinner together.
[trusting] I dreamt the council kept every promise it ever made. I think it might really be trying.
[tribal] I dreamt the elders sat by the fire and spoke for all of us, and the spirits nodded along.

warm.li: I dreamt of the council, all of us together, deciding things kindly. We can be like that.

blunt.li: Dreamt the council got something right. Fine. I'll give them a chance.

cheerful.li: I dreamt the council was the best council in the whole world! Maybe it is!

gloomy.li: I dreamt the council was fair to everyone. Maybe that's not as far off as I think.

cold.li: A dream of a functional council. Unusual. I'll extend some provisional trust.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the empty chamber

plain.li: I dreamt the council chamber was empty, and the decisions were being made by the wind.
I dreamt I brought a petition to the council, and they folded it into a paper bird and threw it into the fire.
I dreamt the council were all wearing masks, and underneath the masks were more masks.
[bitter|doubtful] I dreamt the council had decided everything years ago, and we were all just acting it out.
[again] The empty chamber again. The wind is still in charge.

warm.li: I dreamt the council had forgotten all of us. I hope that's not true. I'd like to be wrong.

blunt.li: Dreamt the council was a row of empty chairs. Not much different.

gloomy.li: I dreamt nobody was in charge at all. I'm not sure that was a dream.

cold.li: A dream of an absent council. Possibly accurate. I'll watch them more closely.

plain.li: I dreamt my room had turned into a garden overnight, with vines over the bed and flowers on the windowsill.
I dreamt I woke up next to a plant that had grown all night just to say good morning.
[winter] I dreamt it was spring inside my room while the snow fell outside. Just one pot. That would do.

warm.li: I dreamt of green things growing beside my bed. I'd like that. Something living to look after.

blunt.li: Dreamt of plants in my room. Want one. That's all.

cheerful.li: I dreamt my room was a jungle! I want a plant! Maybe two!

gloomy.li: I dreamt of a garden. Then I woke up to bare walls.

cold.li: I dreamt of greenery in my quarters. The preference is clear. I'll raise it.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the white giant

plain.li: I dreamt a pale giant with a single horn walked along the edge of the world, slow as a cloud. It didn't even look at us.
I dreamt something huge and gentle passed the colony in the night, and the ground was warm where it stepped.
[tribal] I dreamt the great white spirit walked past our fires, and the elders said not to anger it.

warm.li: I dreamt something old and kind walked past us and wished us well. I hope it comes back.

cheerful.li: I dreamt of a giant white beast with a horn! It looked so soft! I want to pet it!

cold.li: I dreamt of an enormous white animal. Valuable, and dangerous. I'd leave it be.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the burning stone

plain.li: I dreamt a stone fell out of the sky, burning, and when it cooled it was full of shining veins.
I dreamt the sky threw a rock at us. It missed, on purpose I think, and left us a gift.
[tribal] I dreamt the sky spirits dropped a burning stone into our valley, and when the elders cracked it open it was full of metal.

warm.li: I dreamt a star fell near us and didn't hurt anyone. It just wanted to be close.

cold.li: A dream of a meteor strike. Statistically unlikely. I'd still keep clear of open ground for a few days.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the broken ship

plain.li: I dreamt pieces of a great ship were raining down, and every piece was humming a different song.
I dreamt a ship far above us broke apart like a dropped plate, and some of it came down here.
[spacer] I dreamt of an old ship dying in orbit, coming apart piece by piece. I recognised the sound.
[tribal] I dreamt the iron birds fought in the sky, and one of them fell to pieces over our hills.

gloomy.li: I dreamt a ship broke apart overhead. Whoever was on it never made it down.

cold.li: I dreamt of falling wreckage. Salvage, if it lands somewhere convenient.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the sweet grove

plain.li: I dreamt of a grove that grew overnight, with fruit that tasted like laughing.
I dreamt I followed a sweet smell into the trees and found everyone from the colony there, eating and singing.
[trait:ChemicalInterest|trait:ChemicalFascination] I dreamt of a fruit that made everything feel right, growing wild somewhere close. I can almost smell it.

warm.li: I dreamt the land gave us something sweet, just because. I'll keep an eye out.

cheerful.li: I dreamt of magic fruit growing just outside the walls! Let's go look!

cold.li: I dreamt of a fruit with pleasant effects, growing nearby. Worth investigating.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the mad eyes

plain.li: I dreamt the animals came out of the trees all at once, running the same way, with madness in their eyes.
I dreamt every animal in the forest woke up angry, and they all knew where we lived.
[skill:Animals] I dreamt I tried to calm a herd, and every one of them looked at me with someone else's eyes.

blunt.li: Dreamt of animals coming for us. Mad ones. Keep the doors shut.

gloomy.li: I dreamt even the animals hate us now. Maybe they always did.

cold.li: I dreamt of a stampede aimed at the colony. Keep the doors closed for a few days. It costs nothing.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the silent machines

plain.li: I dreamt every machine in the colony held its breath at once, and the lights went out, and the sun was laughing.
I dreamt the sun reached down and pressed its thumb on everything that hums.
[tribal|medieval] I dreamt the sun grew angry at the strangers' machines and struck them all dumb.

blunt.li: Dreamt the power died. All of it. Charge what you can.

cheerful.li: I dreamt all the machines took a nap at the same time! Even they need a rest!

cold.li: I dreamt of a total electrical failure. I'd make sure nothing vital depends on power for the next few days.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the closed eye

plain.li: I dreamt the sun closed its eye in the middle of the day, and everything went quiet and grey.
I dreamt someone hung a blanket over the sky, and the crops looked up and waited.
[tribal] I dreamt the great wolf swallowed the sun and wouldn't give it back for days.

cheerful.li: I dreamt it was night in the daytime! Like a whole day of bedtime stories!

gloomy.li: I dreamt the sun turned its back on us. Fitting.

cold.li: I dreamt of darkness at midday. Bad for the crops, bad for solar power. I'd plan accordingly.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the burning wind

plain.li: I dreamt a hot wind came and didn't stop, and the birds walked instead of flying.
I dreamt the sun came down to live with us for a while, and it didn't know how to be a quiet guest.
[old] I dreamt of a summer so hot it cracked the riverbed. I've lived through one like that before.

blunt.li: Dreamt it got hot. Really hot. Find some shade.

cheerful.li: I dreamt it was so hot we cooked eggs on the roof! Free breakfast!

cold.li: I dreamt of extreme heat. I'd check the shade and the water.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the feathered hat

plain.li: I dreamt lots of people came to visit, and one of them had a hat with a feather in it, and they were nice to me.
I dreamt strangers walked up to our gate waving, and they had stories, and nobody had to fight.
I dreamt we had guests, and all the grown-ups were on their best behaviour. It was funny.

cheerful.li: I dreamt we had visitors and they brought sweets! I'm going to wait by the gate!

gloomy.li: I dreamt people came to visit and nobody talked to me. Maybe they will this time.

cold.li: I dreamt of visitors. I'm going to watch them very carefully when they come.
